newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares indefatigable in face of U.S. fall.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares indefatigable in face of U.S. fall.

text.p: Danish share prices opened higher on Thursday, with dealers seeing good underlying sentiment cushioning prices from the worst effects of last night's Wall Street downturn.
"We expect an unchanged to slightly declining market today. There is still a strong positive undertone" a dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index on Wednesday had started to rally but a sharp fall by Danisco helped pull it 0.28 point down to 172.00.
It opened on Thursday with an immediate O.11 point rise to 172.11. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969650
